import pandas as pd,numpy as np
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet')
c='count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL'
w['r']=w[c]/w.n_passages;w['late']=w.year>=1876
def est(d):
  g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack().dropna();return (g[True]-g[False]).mean()
rng=np.random.default_rng(0);bs=[]
groups={k:v.r.values for k,v in w.groupby(['genre','late'])}
for i in range(5000):
  m={k:rng.choice(v,len(v)).mean() for k,v in groups.items()}
  gs=set(k[0] for k in m);bs.append(np.mean([m[(g,True)]-m[(g,False)] for g in gs]))
print(np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]),np.mean(np.array(bs)>0))
print('high',est(w[w.date_confidence=='high']),'>1850',est(w[w.year>1850]),'known origin',est(w[w.origin!='unknown']),'1ed',est(w[w.n_editions==1]))
print(w.groupby('decade').r.mean().round(3).to_dict())
print(w.groupby('author_key').size().describe())
print(w[w[c]>0].sample(8,random_state=1).passage_ids.tolist())
